eps.t: Holiday Throwdown: There's No Place Like Ham
eps.o: Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson welcome guest chefs Damaris Phillips and Viet Pham to kick off the holiday chaos with a spirited game of Spin the Bottle. Plus, it's the girls versus the guys this season, as Brooke's team includes chefs Antonia Lofaso and Ayesha Nurdjaja, while Bobby has chefs Michael Voltaggio and Michael Jenkins in his corner. Things get even smokier as the kitchen heats up…

eps.t: Holiday Throwdown: Swim with the Fishes
eps.o: Guest chefs Tiffani Faison and Gabe Bertaccini dive headfirst into Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson's holiday madness with a chaotic game of "Find the Pickle." Then, the teams face off in a high-stakes Feast of the Seven Fishes cook-off.
